mapper.update: CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_all_ids ON COMMIT DROP AS WITH eai AS ( SELECT * FROM itfown.eai_usertgt_rcv WHERE LEFT(recv_time, 8) >= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND LEFT(recv_time, 8) < TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day', 'YYYYMMDD') AND (deal_stat IS NULL OR deal_stat = 'N') AND userid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(userid) <> '' ), with_existing AS ( SELECT e.*, u.user_id AS existing_user_id FROM eai e LEFT JOIN fmsown.tb_scm_user u ON u.lgn_id = e.userid AND u.user_clsf_cd = 'PAR' ), new_users AS ( SELECT * FROM with_existing WHERE existing_user_id IS NULL ), inserted AS ( INSERT INTO fmsown.tb_scm_user ( user_id, user_clsf_cd, lgn_id, user_nm, emp_no, crt_user_id, crt_dt, updt_user_id, updt_dt ) SELECT 'PAR' || LPAD(NEXTVAL('FMSOWN.TB_SCM_USER_SEQ')::TEXT, 8, '0'), 'PAR', userid, username, employeenumber, 'system', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'system', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM new_users RETURNING user_id, lgn_id ), all_ids AS ( SELECT e.*, COALESCE(e.existing_user_id, i.user_id) AS target_user_id FROM with_existing e LEFT JOIN inserted i ON i.lgn_id = e.userid ) SELECT * FROM all_ids

UPDATE fmsown.tb_scm_user u SET user_nm = a.username, emp_no = a.employeenumber, updt_user_id = 'system', updt_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM sync_all_ids a WHERE u.lgn_id = a.userid AND u.user_clsf_cd = 'PAR'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fmsown.tb_scm_user_parco ( user_id, parco_user_id, user_pswd, user_orgnl_id, user_photo_file, user_nm, user_eng_nm, emp_no, dept_cd, dept_nm, indct_jbps_cd, indct_jbps_cd_nm, jbgd_cd, jbgd_nm, jbps_cd, jbps_nm, jbttl_cd, jbttl_nm, duty_cd, duty_nm, reg_ynd, jncmp_ynd, rsgntn_ymd, eml_dmn_addr, work_stts_cd, ofc_telno, co_fxno, co_zip, co_addr, co_daddr, gndr_cd, ext_telno, emp_se_cd, co_cd, co_nm, hghrk_dept_cd, hghrk_dept_nm, powk_cd, powk_nm, ocpt_nm, ocpt_cd, cstct_nm, cstct_cd, work_rul_nm, work_rul_cd, last_prmt_ymd, prp_grd_no, ntnlty_nm, if_dt, crt_user_id, crt_ot, updt_user_id, updt_ot ) SELECT a.target_user_id, a.userid, a.passwd, a.originaluid, a.photo, a.username, a.engusername, a.employeenumber, a.oucode, a.ou, a.dippos, a.dipposname, a.grade, a.gradename, a.position, a.positionname, a.titlecode, a.titlename, a.dutycode, a.dutyname, a.createdate, a.joindate, a.deletedate, a.email, COALESCE(a.status, '0'), a.officedeptphone, a.officefax, a.officezip, a.officeaddress, a.officeaddressdetail, COALESCE(a.gender, '0'), a.officepersonalphone, COALESCE(a.usertype, '0'), a.companyid, a.companyname, a.topoucode, a.topou, a.workplacecode, a.workplace, a.worktype, a.worktypecode, a.costcenter, a.costcentercode, a.workrule, a.workrulecode, a.lastpromotiondate, a.proposalgrade, a.nationality, COALESCE(TO_TIMESTAMP(a.send_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 'system', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'system', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM sync_all_ids a WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fmsown.tb_scm_user_parco p WHERE p.parco_user_id = a.userid )
mapper.update: UPDATE fmsown.tb_scm_user_parco p SET user_pswd = a.passwd, user_orgnl_id = a.originaluid, user_photo_file = a.photo, user_nm = a.username, user_eng_nm = a.engusername, emp_no = a.employeenumber, dept_cd = a.oucode, dept_nm = a.ou, indct_jbps_cd = a.dippos, indct_jbps_cd_nm = a.dipposname, jbgd_cd = a.grade, jbgd_nm = a.gradename, jbps_cd = a.position, jbps_nm = a.positionname, jbttl_cd = a.titlecode, jbttl_nm = a.titlename, duty_cd = a.dutycode, duty_nm = a.dutyname, reg_ynd = a.createdate, jncmp_ynd = a.joindate, rsgntn_ymd = a.deletedate, eml_dmn_addr = a.email, work_stts_cd = COALESCE(a.status, p.work_stts_cd), ofc_telno = a.officedeptphone, co_fxno = a.officefax, co_zip = a.officezip, co_addr = a.officeaddress, co_daddr = a.officeaddressdetail, gndr_cd = COALESCE(a.gender, p.gndr_cd), ext_telno = a.officepersonalphone, emp_se_cd = COALESCE(a.usertype, p.emp_se_cd), co_cd = a.companyid, co_nm = a.companyname, hghrk_dept_cd = a.topoucode, hghrk_dept_nm = a.topou, powk_cd = a.workplacecode, powk_nm = a.workplace, ocpt_nm = a.worktype, ocpt_cd = a.worktypecode, cstct_nm = a.costcenter, cstct_cd = a.costcentercode, work_rul_nm = a.workrule, work_rul_cd = a.workrulecode, last_prmt_ymd = a.lastpromotiondate, prp_grd_no = a.proposalgrade, ntnlty_nm = a.nationality, if_dt = COALESCE(TO_TIMESTAMP(a.send_time, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), p.if_dt), updt_user_id = 'system', updt_ot = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM sync_all_ids a WHERE p.user_id = a.target_user_id AND p.parco_user_id = a.userid
UPDATE itfown.eai_usertgt_rcv r SET deal_stat = 'S' FROM sync_all_ids a WHERE r.unitsystemid = a.unitsystemid AND r.messageid = a.messageid AND r.dateandtime = a.dateandtime
UPDATE itfown.esb_link SET link_job_stts_cd = 'S' WHERE link_tbl_nm = 'itfown.eai_usertgt_rcv' AND link_job_stts_cd = 'N' AND link_dt >= CURRENT_DATE
